verified_facts.text: Grand Hyatt Dubai is a city resort surrounded by 37 acres of gardens overlooking Dubai Creek.
verified_facts.excerpt: a city resort surrounded by 37 acres of lush gardens overlooking the iconic Creek

verified_facts.text: The hotel is located near the airport and major attractions, combining resort living with city access.
verified_facts.excerpt: Ideally located near the airport and major attractions, the hotel blends serene resort living with effortless city access.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is just outside of downtown Dubai.
verified_facts.excerpt: Stay at our luxury hotel just outside of downtown Dubai
a spectacular 20,000 sqm waterpark, and the acclaimed Ahasees Spa

verified_facts.text: Grand Hyatt Dubai Waterpark has 16 signature attractions and is designed for all generations.
verified_facts.excerpt: Home to 16 signature attractions, Grand Hyatt Dubai Waterpark is thoughtfully designed for all generations

verified_facts.text: The hotel has two outdoor pools and an indoor pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Grand Hyatt Dubai offers 2 outdoor pools, including one of the largest leisure pools in the city, and a 20-metre indoor pool.

verified_facts.text: Ahasees Spa & Club experiences are guided by three core philosophies: Trade, Flourish and Evolve.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guided by three core philosophies — Trade, Flourish, and Evolve — each experience is thoughtfully curated to nurture the body, calm the mind, and elevate the senses.

verified_facts.text: The fitness centre at Ahasees Spa & Club has separate zones with cardio and strength-training equipment.
verified_facts.excerpt: wellness enthusiasts can enjoy different levels of fitness activities in separate zones that feature cardio and strength-training equipment

verified_facts.text: Skyline View rooms have Dubai skyline views and contemporary decor with Arabian touches.
verified_facts.excerpt: Revel in stunning Dubai skyline views from this 39-square-metre room with contemporary decor and Arabian touches.

verified_facts.text: Rooms have an Italian bathroom with twin basins and a separate tub and shower.
verified_facts.excerpt: The room features one king bed, Italian bathroom with twin basins and separate tub and shower, along with a generous work area.

verified_facts.text: Superior rooms are adorned with Arabian influences and have views of Dubai's historic creek and parklands.
verified_facts.excerpt: Unwind in a spacious 44-square-meter room adorned with Arabian influences and boasting breathtaking views of Dubai's historic creek and parklands.

verified_facts.text: The 2 Bedroom Royal Suite has a spacious parlor, dining for eight, a kitchenette and a marble bathroom with a jetted spa bathtub.
verified_facts.excerpt: spacious parlor, dining for eight, kitchenette, wetbar, work area with minibar, complimentary high-speed internet, and marble bathroom with jetted spa bathtub, shower, and bidet

verified_facts.text: Butler service is available on request in the 2 Bedroom Royal Suite.
verified_facts.excerpt: Butler service is available on request.

verified_facts.text: Panini is a delicatessen set amid tropical indoor gardens and waterfalls, known for its strawberry cheesecake.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set amid tropical indoor gardens and flowing waterfalls, Panini is a classic delicatessen offering specialty house-made breads, pastries, and gelato. Known for its signature strawberry cheesecake

verified_facts.text: Wox serves Pan-Asian street-food-inspired dishes at an intimate chef's table where the chef cooks over woks.
verified_facts.excerpt: Wox draws inspiration from Pan-Asian street food and brings it to an intimate chef

verified_facts.text: The hotel has indoor and outdoor wedding venues with personalized planning.
verified_facts.excerpt: With elegant indoor and outdoor venues, personalized planning, and thoughtful details

verified_facts.text: The hotel offers 12,500 square metres of event space, from ballrooms to meeting rooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: Grand Hyatt Dubai offers 12,500 square metres of flexible event space, from grand ballrooms to intimate meeting rooms

verified_facts.text: Valet parking is complimentary for hotel guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: Valet parking is available and is complimentary for hotel guests or guests attending hotel-based events.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has three complimentary EV chargers.
verified_facts.excerpt: We also feature three complimentary EV chargers, available 24 hours, with no reservation required.
